conformanceUnits.name: ASE-Execution
conformanceUnits.description: Complete (§5), the deferral rules of §6 including the opt-in and the retry contract, the lifecycle of §7 excluding §7.7 auditing, the CompleteRequest, CompleteResponse, DeferralRequestHeaderDataType, DeferralResponseHeaderDataType and DeferredRequestState DataTypes (§9.3), and the StatusCodes of §10. Requires ASE-Model.

conformanceUnits.name: ASE-Model
conformanceUnits.description: AsyncServiceCapabilitiesType and the well-known AsyncServiceCapabilities Object (§9.1). Requires ASE-Execution.

conformanceUnits.name: ASE-Diagnostics
conformanceUnits.description: AsyncServiceDiagnosticsType, the well-known AsyncServiceDiagnostics Object, DeferredRequestDiagnosticsDataType and the two projections of §9.2. Requires ASE-Execution.

conformanceUnits.name: ASE-CompletionEvents
conformanceUnits.description: DeferredRequestCompletedEventType and the delivery restriction of §9.4. Requires ASE-Execution.

conformanceUnits.name: ASE-Auditing
conformanceUnits.description: AuditDeferredRequestEventType, DeferredRequestTransition, and the obligation to raise an Event on every transition, with the outcomes and the delivery restriction of §7.7. Requires ASE-Execution.
